title: position
description: The position memo of phase P2 (Implementation Decisions 10, position): what the critic returns after reading only the dossiers, INTAKE.md, and OBJECTIVES.md (decision 17), and from which code renders research/POSITION.md. The schema holds the shape; wayline.position holds the rest: every prior-work row's reference is resolved by the scout and a row that is not existence: verified is dropped with a note, there is one row in objectives for each open or parked objective and a revised target only for a goal, the three directions are ranked by their distance from the intent, none lies beyond the project's radius, and the objectives a direction names are ones the project holds or new ones it proposes.

intent.description: the intent as INTAKE.md states it, in one sentence of your own

prior_work.description: the closest prior work, nearest first; only works you read about in a dossier, never one you remember

reference.description: the dossier's slug (the directory under research/refs/), or for a work a dossier cites but no dossier holds, its DOI, arXiv id, or exact title; the harness has the scout resolve it and drops a row it cannot verify

reports.description: what the work reports, in a sentence, as its dossier says it

bearing.description: what it means for the intent: the same question, a competing explanation, a method to reuse, a result that makes the intent moot

locator.description: where in the dossier you read it (research/refs/<slug>/dossier.md#Results, dossier.json#abstract), or null

missing_prior_work.description: work the dossiers lack that a reader of this intent would expect beside them, above all competing methods for the same task; named from what you know, so the harness marks them unverified and the owner decides whether to add them

feasibility.description: whether the intent can be carried out with the compute and the data INTAKE.md states

compute.description: the compute stated, and what the work needs of it

data.description: the data stated, and whether it can answer the question

reasoning.description: why, in a paragraph; name what the intake leaves unsaid

objectives.description: one row for each open or parked objective of OBJECTIVES.md, in id order: whether it looks within reach of this project; empty when no objective is recorded yet

reasoning.description: why, with the numbers you read and where; for a goal with no measured baseline, the path to a defensible target instead of a number; for an objective without a measure, what would answer it

revised_target.description: for a goal (an objective with a measure) only: a target to propose instead, required when the verdict is out_of_reach and null when it is reachable; null too when no baseline is measured and nothing read justifies a number, and always null for an objective without a measure; the goal itself is the owner's to change

value.description: the target in the goal's own metric and units

why.description: why this number is reachable: the theoretical argument, or the measured or reported value it rests on with its locator

hostile_review.description: the objections a hostile reviewer would raise against the intent as stated, worst first, each one sentence or two

concerns.description: one row for each concern of CONCERNS.md that waits to be sorted, in id order (decision 17; ticket 96): where it goes, tied to one objective row of this memo, kept for the paper order, or declined; the owner settles each at the grill. Leave it out, or empty, when no concern waits

place.description: objective: the work on one objective answers it; order: the paper answers it at the order (a wording, a detail, a response); decline: the work should not take it up

objective.description: the objective row it is tied to, for place objective; null otherwise

reason.description: why it goes there, in a sentence; for a decline, the reason the owner reads

directions.description: three directions the project could take, nearest to the intent first, none farther than the project's radius

distance.description: how far from the intent, on the radius's own scale

title.description: the direction in a few words

text.description: what it would do, and what it would show, in two or three sentences

objectives.description: the objectives this direction would pursue, as proposals the grill puts to the owner: one OBJECTIVES.md holds, by its id, or a new question with id null

id.description: the id of an objective OBJECTIVES.md holds, or null for a new one this direction proposes

text.description: the objective's question, as OBJECTIVES.md words it, or the new question in one sentence
